_fields.speed: number - Movement speed in pixels per second
_fields.damage: number - Attack damage dealt to player
_fields.xpValue: number - Experience points awarded when defeated
_fields.attackRange: number - Optional; ranged enemies stop this far short of the wall
_fields.isBoss: boolean - Optional; shows the boss health bar
_fields.isFinalBoss: boolean - Optional; killing it wins the run
_fields.hasShield: boolean - Optional; blocks projectiles until a piercing projectile breaks the shield
_fields.slowImmune: boolean - Optional; ignores slow and freeze
_fields.explodeDamage: number - Optional; explodes for this much wall damage on reaching the wall (no reward)
_fields.splitInto: string - Optional; enemy type it splits into when killed
_fields.splitCount: number - Optional; how many enemies it splits into
_fields.phaseInterval: number - Optional; seconds per phase cycle
_fields.phaseDuration: number - Optional; seconds untargetable at the end of each phase cycle
_fields.summonInterval: number - Optional; seconds between raising enemies
_fields.summonCount: number - Optional; enemies raised each time
_fields.summonType: string - Optional; enemy type raised (default swarmling)
_fields.burrows: boolean - Optional; untargetable underground until near the wall
_fields.surfaceDistance: number - Optional; surfaces this far short of its stop point
